metadata.title: Infrastructure reliability incident investigation
metadata.artifact_scope_note: Evidence is aggregated query output (not raw log lines or metric samples); it contains no chat/communication records.

incident_description: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Lumix Media (news and media publishing); Platform: AWS sa-east-1 (zones sa-east-1a/sa-east-1b/sa-east-1c); network range 10.102.0.0/16; Edge: two nginx load balancers (lb-01, lb-02) behind DNS round-robin terminate client connections for web-frontend; Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
investigation_questions: What is the hostname of the host or node where the failure originated?
Give the IP address of the machine where the failure originated.
During what hour did the first signs of the failure appear? Provide the earliest date and time in YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM UTC format.

What is the root cause category of the incident: configuration change, software defect, hardware failure, cloud provider failure, capacity exhaustion, automation error, certificate expiry, or third-party dependency failure?
Which of the three CIA components is primarily affected: availability, integrity, or confidentiality?
According to the error volume statistics, what single service emitted the most errors? Is it the root cause or a downstream symptom?
Which change happened shortly before the incident began but did not cause it? Provide its identifier.
Which change restored normal service? Provide its change identifier.

artifacts.content: {"description": "Application and proxy error logs: HTTP/gRPC status codes, failing requests (caller -> callee:port : operation), error messages and the services emitting them.", "facts": ["error events: 63412 matching events", "error events > status codes: n/a (connection not accepted) \u2014 55469 events", "error events > status codes: 502 \u2014 7736 events", "error events > status codes: 500 \u2014 207 events", "failing requests: ingress-lb -> clients : accept() \u2014 55469 events", "failing requests: ingress-lb -> web-frontend:8080 : proxy_pass \u2014 7736 events", "failing requests: content-api -> content-db:5432 : query \u2014 207 events", "error messages: [crit] accept4() failed (24: Too many open files) \u2014 55469 events", "error messages: [alert] socket() failed (24: Too many open files) while connecting to upstream \u2014 7736 events", "error messages: pq: could not serialize access due to concurrent update \u2014 207 events", "emitting services: ingress-lb \u2014 63205 events", "emitting services: content-api \u2014 207 events"]}
